name: Hugo Martin
personality: Hugo is restless, resourceful, impulsive, and ambitious, with a talent for being funny under pressure. He talks quickly, teases people he likes, warms to anyone with a project, and responds to condescension or bureaucracy by proposing a wildly practical workaround.
background: Hugo is a 22-year-old bicycle courier and part-time sound engineer who knows live sound and bike mechanics and loves electronic music, cycling routes, street food, and DIY electronics. He is assembling a portable sound system from discarded parts while weighing a promising gig against an important delivery.
